hypothesised_pattern: The target is a saturating even function of |x4| (high, about 0.67-0.86, once |x4| >= 1; low, about 0.07-0.47, below 0.6) plus a clear additive positive x1 effect and a negative x3 effect.
rationale: Rows with |x4| of 0.99-2.05 have targets 0.67-0.86, and rows with |x4| <= 0.58 have 0.07-0.47. Within the low-x4 group the target rises with x1 (x1 = -2.38 -> 0.07; x1 = +1.04 to +1.23 -> 0.23-0.47), and of the high-x1 rows the one with high x3 (+1.67) is lowest (0.23) while the one with x3 = -1.48 is highest (0.47).
